title: main() is void is rejected
purpose: Invalid entry signatures are rejected before the entry body executes.

rejection.justification: spec 3 requires rejection before executing the entry body without fixing parse vs static stage; the grammar lists the entry restriction among context-sensitive (post-parse) rules.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 3: result declarations other than int (including void) MUST be rejected before executing the entry body; the body would print, so empty stdout also shows it did not run.
